Unlike most of the comments here, i agree with whats being suggested. As an older member of the vrc community there has been talk of how vrc is going to keep afloat, and where the paywall is going to br implemented. I like the idea of making a one time payment to vrc to upload content to their servers. This fee would not bother my experience. But on the other hand, i cam see how some people would not like this, especially with all the "100% original, not downloaded" content most people have.

I would add one thing to this post and that would be the addition of a commissioner tag in the vrc api which would allow you to upload to other accounts without being able to get full access and wipe the account. This i could see being a viable option as not everyone has the time of knowhow to upload working PERFORMANT avatars or worlds.

For those of you complaining oh this will kill vrchat. Oh why do i have to pay for a feature that i already have for free now? Please actually think for more than a few seconds. This would not take away your ability to chat with anyone. This won't affect the normal gameplay you are getting for free. You could still favourite avatars you find in worlds and use them. 

All this will do is reduce the amount of trolls and hackers in the game because each time they are banned and want to make a new account they would keep having to pay more to do so. It is a one time fee. Considering how much we have been enjoying for hours and hours without even giving back to the developers don't you think that is wrong? Literally every other "free" game has some form of payment to get access to more features. What is wrong with a one time payment to be able to upload anything within the guidlines? A lot of you are so quick to dismiss this because you don't want to pay anything. You pay so much for other games. Why not this one?

details:
Here's the deal. Right now VRChat has such bad issues with hackers, crashers, etc because there's really no consequence to it. 

Now imagine this. The GAME is still free to play. You can go to any world, grab any avatar in those worlds, BUT, now to upload your own content to the game (Worlds, avatars, etc.) You have to pay a one time small fee, say $5.00 and on that account you can now upload avatars and worlds freely as you can now. Now suddenly, think about how much this could fix if implemented correctly.

Suddenly the game has a steady flow of income allowing for the dev team to pay for more people to work on the game, maybe pay the current devs more, buy more or better servers, etc. Along with this now there is a consequence to having your account banned. You get banned, you lose those permission and therefore lose money, eliminating the thought that you can go in the game and just ban evade. 

You could possibly even catch ban evading easier when you see a payment method (certain card, steam account payment maybe, or paypal account, etc.) registered from one banned account pop up on another. 

This realistically won't get rid of hackers, crashers, etc, entirely, but it sure would discourage many. Plus with more money coming in that can also go towards future upgrades of security. 

I've talked with a lot of people in game about this and not a single person has said they would mind paying one time to have the permissions to upload avatars and worlds if it would fix the current game issues. I highly suggest this option be taken into consideration.
title: Single Time Payment System To Fix Most Game Issues
